componentLifecycle.geometry: Preserve the component footprint while labels and semantic roles change; loading and validation must not shift adjacent controls.
componentLifecycle.content: Write the state in words. Empty and error states name the missing input or failed operation plus the next available action.

applicationContract.consumerTokens: Downstream artifacts load root tokens.css once before component CSS. The maintainer-facing applied kit loads canonical colors_and_type.css for package auditing; the entries remain byte-identical.
applicationContract.inventoryRule: Both active component directories contain exactly the allowed file names. Any prototype, alternate palette, or unregistered component is revision evidence and must remain outside the active runtime directories.
applicationContract.contentSafety: Escape every data-driven text and attribute value through BrandEscape before composing HTML. Static trusted geometry may remain literal; user, project, evidence, and status data may not.
applicationContract.typography: Use the named --type-hero-*, --type-section-*, --type-campaign-*, and --type-presentation-* roles before adding a component-specific font-size clamp. Workbench components use hero or section roles; the presentation role is reserved for 2-8 word statements.
applicationContract.surfaceBoundary: Interactive runtime components belong to workbench and product surfaces. Presentations reuse semantic tokens, status language, logos, approved narrative assets, and the five-part system sequence, but use fixed-canvas composition instead of copying component-card markup.
applicationContract.proof: ui_kits/app/index.html loads every runtime file from the registered assets/components/ boundary and renders every active component family. Preview HTML documents the contract but is not the implementation source.
applicationContract.rule: A component is distributed only when its source and registered asset mirror are byte-identical, it appears in the applied kit, and it is documented by this manifest.

distribution.rule: Distribute only the seven runtime files loaded by the applied kit and referenced by this manifest. Archive unreferenced prototypes instead of shipping a second palette or layout system under the same id.

accessibility: Use a labelled nav landmark.
Mark the current destination with aria-current=page.
Connect the mobile disclosure with aria-controls and aria-expanded.
responsive: Keep all three primary pages visible above 820px.
At 820px and below, replace the page row with a labelled disclosure.
Keep track and theme preferences reachable after the disclosure.
navigation.contentIntegrity: Brand Strategy, Brand Presentation, and Brand Guidelines are the only primary pages. Personal and Client remain secondary tracks.

accessibility: Use a native button for actions.
Use aria-pressed only for persistent selection.
Use aria-busy and a real progress label during loading.
responsive: Preserve a 44px target.
Allow labels to wrap when translation or context makes them longer.
Stack primary actions at 600px when horizontal space is tight.
button.contentIntegrity: Use a concrete verb and object. Do not use generic labels such as Learn more when the destination can be named.

accessibility: Write the state label; never rely on color alone.
Keep status and claim in the same reading group.
responsive: Use three columns only when each claim remains readable.
Collapse to two columns at 1024px and one at 600px.
statusPanel.contentIntegrity: The supporting sentence must identify the source, tradeoff, or proof still needed.

accessibility: Keep the visible label outside the placeholder.
Connect every visible hint or validation message with aria-describedby.
Set aria-invalid=true only after validation fails.
Set aria-busy=true while validating.
Use readonly when a value must remain selectable and inspectable; use disabled only when the control is unavailable.
responsive: Keep fields full-width on narrow panels.
Preserve 44px minimum input height.
formField.contentIntegrity: Ask for the exact evidence source or operating input; never imply that missing proof already exists.

accessibility: Use an ordered list.
Direction connectors are decorative reinforcement; every step remains readable in document order.
Write the recovery-to-context learning note rather than relying on a loop arrow alone.
responsive: Five columns with direction connectors on wide screens.
Hide connectors and use document order at 1024px.
Use one column at 600px.
systemMap.contentIntegrity: Always include Context, Work, Checks, Handoffs, and Recovery. Do not convert the map into invented progress percentages or imply that recovery ends the workflow.

accessibility: Use aria-pressed for the readiness control.
Keep decorative visual scaffolding hidden from assistive technology.
responsive: Three columns on wide screens.
Two columns at 1024px.
One column at 600px.
projectEvidence.contentIntegrity: Replace the Open visual only with owned evidence. Never generate a fake product result, client outcome, or terminal capture.

accessibility: Treat a repeated decorative symbol as empty-alt when the adjacent brand name is present.
responsive: Keep the tile square and preserve the 255 by 211 source proportion inside it.
logoTile.contentIntegrity: Center the visible glyph optically. Do not recolor, stretch, shadow, or add the descriptor to the permanent mark geometry.

accessibility: Use native buttons.
Expose the current choice with aria-pressed.
Do not use an icon-only theme control.
responsive: Keep each option at least 44px high.
Allow the pair to wrap without horizontal page scroll.
themeControl.contentIntegrity: Theme changes semantic roles on one owned root. Components do not carry separate hard-coded dark palettes.

anatomy: charcoal on near-white and near-white on charcoal without geometry changes
visible label unless the control already has an accessible name
accessibility: Set aria-hidden=true for an icon adjacent to a visible text label.
When a compact control is legitimately icon-only, provide an aria-label and retain a 44px target.
Never use an icon as the sole evidence of status, validation, or recovery.
responsive: Render at 20px inside controls and 24px in documentation; do not scale the stroke into a decorative illustration.
utilityIcon.contentIntegrity: Use only for navigation, disclosure, direction, copy, evidence request, recovery, and written-state reinforcement. Bind color through the semantic icon roles and keep currentColor intact so the same geometry works on light and dark surfaces. Static Showcase proofs inline the canonical geometry instead of depending on an external use reference. Do not place an icon beside every heading or invent an icon for a missing asset.

anatomy: next action when recovery is possible
accessibility: Use role=status for non-urgent updates and role=alert only when immediate attention is required.
Keep the written state in the message; never rely on fill color alone.
Move focus only when the user must correct a specific field.
responsive: Allow the message to wrap.
Keep any recovery action at least 44px high and adjacent in reading order.
feedbackMessage.contentIntegrity: Name what happened, what remains safe, and the next available action. Do not turn every error into a success story.

accessibility: Describe the operating evidence shown, not its decorative appearance.
Set aria-busy=true during loading.
Keep captions outside clipping media regions.
Keep a recovery action adjacent in reading order.
Do not use background images for evidence that needs alternative text.
responsive: Preserve the source aspect ratio until a crop is explicitly documented.
Stack the media and caption when a horizontal arrangement would make the proof unreadable.
evidenceMedia.contentIntegrity: Only owned evidence replaces an Open plate. Keep third-party moodboard material contained and labelled as reference, never proof.
